camel_example: aliyun dyplsapi QuerySecretNoDetail --region cn-hangzhou --PoolKey FC22580000 --SecretNo 13900000000 --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the property information of a private number
description_zh: 查询隐私号码的属性信息
name: QuerySecretNoDetail

parameters.help_en:
The privacy number, which is the X number.

Log on to the Phone Number Protection console and obtain the X number on the Number Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list) page. Alternatively, view the SecretNo parameter in the response when you call a number binding operation such as BindAxb (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-bindaxb)
parameters.help_zh:
隐私号码，即X号码。

请登录号码隐私保护控制台，在号码管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list)页面获取X号码，或者在调用BindAxb (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-bindaxb?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a807e38uud6C5)等号码绑定接口时查看返回参数中的SecretNo
parameters.name: secret_no

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

Log on to the Phone Number Protection console and obtain the Number Pool Key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码详见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

CertifyStatus.description_en:
The number verification status. Valid values:

0: Unverified.
1: Verified
CertifyStatus.description_zh:
号码认证状态。取值：

0：未认证。
1：已认证

PurchaseTime.description_en: The purchase time of the number, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
PurchaseTime.description_zh: 号码购买时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

SecretStatus.description_en:
The number status. Valid values:

0: Unbound.
1: Bound.
2: Locked.
3: Frozen
SecretStatus.description_zh:
号码状态。取值：

0：未绑定。
1：已绑定。
2：已锁定。
3：已冻结

Vendor.description_en:
The carrier. Valid values:

1: China Mobile
2: China Unicom
3: China Telecom
Vendor.description_zh:
